title: Scan {{mode}}

info.label: How scanning works
info.title: Scanning your pantry
info.intro: Pick a mode, frame it inside the corners, tap the shutter.
info.tip: Every photo is read in the background. Keep shooting, then tap the photos at the bottom left to review everything at once.
info.barcode: Point at a barcode; each one is added on its own

noCamera: The camera is not available. Import a photo instead.

crop.title: Crop receipt
crop.instruction: Drag and zoom so the whole receipt fits the frame.

guide.receipt: Hold the phone about 40 cm above the receipt so its edges touch the guide.
guide.receiptFold: For long receipts, fold where the guide ends (about every 20 items), flip the folded part over, and take the next photo.

detail.product: Adds it to your Pantry with its best-before date.
detail.receipt: Adds every item from your shop in one go.
detail.plate: Writes the recipe for the one you pick as a Recipe Draft for you to finish and save.
detail.ingredients: Adds each loose item on the counter to your Pantry.
